posts.text:
The internet wants you dumb and angry.
I wrote 5,000 words trying to do something different.
The strongest arguments for and against the SAVE America Act (Trump’s “VOTER I.D.” Bill)  — from serious people on BOTH sides.
Read it here: vanjones.substack.com/p/chea…

Two blind spots nobody is talking about:
Pro-bill advocates: The 83% who "support voter I.D." were asked about a STATE photo I.D. — not a birth certificate or passport. That's a bait-and-switch.
Anti-bill critics: Calling it Jim Crow 2.0 ignores that rural white conservative voters would also face barriers. Precision matters.

Everyone agrees: only citizens should vote.
The debate isn't WHETHER. It's HOW and what it costs.
Your driver's license won't work under Trump’s bill. Neither will your REAL ID. We're talking passport-level ID for 160 million registered voters.
That's a different conversation than simple "voter I.D."

Kansas tried this law. For FIVE years.
Citizens unfairly blocked from voting: 31,000
Noncitizens caught voting: 11
That means 2,800 Americans turned away for every unlawful vote stopped.
That's not exactly voting security!

I read Trump's SAVE America Bill so you don't have to.
Neither side is telling you the full story.
Here is every serious argument for AND against it — no spin, no algorithm bait. Make up your own mind.

Is Trump’s ‘Voter I.D.’ Bill ready for the real world? Or would it throw the system into CHAOS right before the midterms? 

Read my cheat sheet here: open.substack.com/pub/vanjon…
CHEAT SHEET: Every Argument For & Against Trump’s “SAVE America Act” (‘Voter I.D.’) -open.substack.com/pub/vanjon…

Donald Trump says the Save America Act will guarantee Republican wins for the next 50 years.

Ironically, I think it might do the opposite.

If this bill passes, elderly and rural voters who have voted for DECADES will face new barriers to voting. Their drivers licenses won’t be enough in most cases. And these voters often do not have passports or other official paperwork. If it passes, they will have to dig through closets, travel long distances, wait in lines and pay fees — just to vote.

Vide

I’m stuck here with several thousand people at the Houston airport. The wait times just go get through security are up to four hours. … Political leaders— get on with it. Put guardrails on ICE and pay these TSA workers. It’s not that complicated.

Video

I read U.S. President Donald Trump’s SAVE America Act so that you don’t have to. Surprise, surprise! Neither side is telling you the full story on this one.

Take a moment to understand the best of both sides' arguments: vanjones.substack.com/p/chea…

I wanted to bring @elicalebon into this conversation for a reason.

Too many people in the West talk about Iran without listening to people who have actually lived the consequences of this regime.

Elica isn’t speaking about this as an abstract policy debate.
Her family was imprisoned by the Islamic Republic.
Her relatives were executed.
Her family fled.
And she has spent years helping people understand what this regime has done — especially to women, dissidents and ordinary Iranians.

In this c

President Trump wants Congress to pass the SAVE Act. He says it's about voter fraud. Some form of voter ID could make sense. But this particular bill could also block millions of eligible Americans from casting a ballot. 

Meanwhile, the country is deeply divided; public faith in free and fair elections is slipping fast. Our democracy runs on trustworthy elections — and right now that trust is imperiled.

Is a “grand bargain” on voting possible? What would a comprehensive agreement that restored

I am back after attending two days of celebration of life ceremonies for the Reverend Jesse Louis Jackson.

I was blown away and humbled by how much impact one human life can have.

Reverend Jackson was born in segregation and poverty. Yet three former U.S. presidents, a former U.S. vice president and three sitting heads of state were among the thousands of people who showed up for his funerals.

Read my full reflection here: open.substack.com/pub/vanjon…
Rev. Jesse Jackson: Hero of Hope - substack.com/home/post/p-188…

Rev. Jesse Louis Jackson, 1941–2026. No equal. No sequel. Rest in power.

Video

Without Jesse Jackson’s 1984 and 1988 campaigns, there is no President Barack Obama. Period. 
That’s not opinion. That’s history. It’s time to put respect on his name. He earned it. And then some.

Video

He didn’t just register voters. He manufactured HOPE. He made millions of people believe that the highest office in the land wasn’t off-limits to someone who looked like them.

Video

He took a country that wanted to put Black ambition in a box — and he blew the box apart. Twice. On national television. In front of the whole world.

Video
